titleEn: Law on Settlement of State’s General Budget for Management in 1997

articles.en:
- Budget revenue implemented by the National Treasury shall be itemised by ministry and public institution in Table 3 attached to this Law. Budget expenditure implemented by the National Treasury shall be itemised by ministry and public institution, approximately and by chapter, in Table 2 attached to this Law.
Table "3" attached to this Law is the list of public investment projects financed from domestic sources which were decided during the period of management of the year 1997 and which are arranged approximately by ministry and public institution.
The summary report of achievements on public investment financed from abroad in respect of debt shall be itemised by budget content, and in respect of expenditure shall be itemised approximately by ministry and public institution, and shall be incorporated consecutively in Tables "3" and "1" attached to this Law.
Table "12" attached to this Law is the list of public investment projects financed from abroad otherwise than from the national treasury, which were decided during the period of management of the year 1997 and which are arranged approximately by ministry and public institution by foreign donor.
